description: The 1985 cult role-playing game where you win not by killing a villain but by mastering eight virtues. Offered for free on GOG.

instructions: 1. Download and install ScummVM (free) from scummvm.org. 2. On the ScummVM games page, download the freeware version of the game and unzip it. 3. In ScummVM, click "Add Game", choose the unzipped folder, then "Start".

titre: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
description: The legendary 1980 Infocom text adventure: explore a vast underground empire by typing your commands. Released as open source by Microsoft in 2025.
instructions: 1. On the GitHub page, open the COMPILED folder and download the file zork1.z3. 2. Go to iplayif.com (a free online player for text adventures) and open the file, or install the free Gargoyle or Frotz app. 3. Type your commands in English, for example "open mailbox" or "go north".
